notes.title: RELEASE NOTE V1.018
notes.notes:
Hi fellow players,

Patch V1.018 is now released:
- Optimized enemy and scenario of Singularity#03~#05.
-Updated lots of unchained enemy behavior and some empowered behavior and skills.
-Players can choose to enhance their combo attack branch and weakness attack branch.
-Players can choose to enhance their shield capabilities.
-Reduced the power of some condensed attack.
-Optimized tutorial.
-Optimized loading time.
-Optimized animations of some enemies.

Enjoy your game!

notes.title: RELEASE NOTE V1.016
notes.notes:
Hi fellow players,

Patch V1.016 is now released:

-Normal/Hard Mode. Enjoy the fight with more leisure. 
-Dialog Display optimized. More readable, with voices!
-Historical event display optimized . 
-Game-play Unlock sequence optimized.
-Tutorial. Text is boring and now the lady will demonstrate the moves.
-We impaired the shield, but it will come back with more intense mechanism. 


Have a good fight!

notes.title: RELEASE NOTE V1.014
notes.notes:
Hi fellow players,

Patch V1.014 is now released:

-Full Oculus Rift support. 
For none-360 players we added camera rotation on right joystick. 
(Please excuse us for the distorted Jab VFX for Rift in this version, we'll get it repaired in V1.015 on Nov 8.)

-Singularity Cube Optimization.

-Canceled the surrender portal at re-spawn point.

-Improved rough-like experience, avoid super-tough levels.

-Lowered difficulty of earlier period even more.


Thank you.

notes.title: RELEASE NOTE V1.013
notes.notes:
Hello,

With V1.012P on Oct 25 solved BLACK SCREEN bug(Gratitude to our players who had been really helpful), we postponed V1.013 on Oct 26. to Oct 28 with more content upgraded.

- Fight Tips when loading.
- Enhanced Rough-like game-play of SINGULARITY#1, #3, #9 and #10. 
- Optimized SKILL and ABILITY display.
- Optimized Babel Tower hints.
- Optimized rendering of SINGULARITY#1 and #7 scenes.

notes.title: RELEASE NOTE V1.012
notes.notes:
Hello,

PATCH 1.012 is now released:

-More intense first hour. 
-Shorter tutorial.
-Optimized UI experience.
-Cut profile selection at launch, integrate it into game options UI.
-Fixed bugs:

Plasma shield display.
Health bar display.
BOOK OF REVELATION entry pick-up.



ABOUT THE BLACK-SCREEN BUG:
This patch reduces the odd. But please wait for the PATCH 1.013 on Oct 26 for sure.
